description: React functional component for the Tic Tac Toe game interface, managing game state, user interactions, and API calls for creating/joining a game and making moves.

methods.name: createGame
methods.description: Creates a new game by calling the backend API and updates the state with the result.

methods.name: fetchAvailableGames
methods.description: Fetches list of available games from the backend API to display joinable games.

methods.name: joinGame
methods.description: Joins an existing game with a specified ID by calling the backend API.

methods.name: getCellSymbol
methods.description: Returns the symbol ('X' or 'O') or empty string for a cell at a given position.

methods.name: makeMove
methods.description: Submits a move at the specified position to the backend API and updates game state.
